intakeStatement: The owner-authorized intake reported a provenance.json that maps original machine, path, mtime, and hash. That file was not present in this workspace, so those three fields are left unreobserved rather than reconstructed.

workspaceCheckoutTimestamp.meaning: Timestamp of the tracked repository files in this checkout. Not an original-machine mtime.

narrowMacDirectoryObservation.statement: No relevant public source, ABI, or bytecode filename was found in the narrowly inspected Mac directory.
narrowMacDirectoryObservation.scope: Scoped observation supplied with the intake. Not re-executed as a host search in this change, and not proof of absence.
